title: lithocarpus sphaerocarpus
intro: Lithocarpus sphaerocarpus, commonly known as the Round-coned Lithocarpus or Round-coned Copper Beech, is a species of plant in the family Fagaceae. This plant is known for its medicinal properties and is used in traditional Chinese medicine, particularly in the treatment of various health conditions. The health benefits of Lithocarpus sphaerocarpus include its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help to reduce inflammation and protect against oxidative stress. The therapeutic actions of Lithocarpus sphaerocarpus include its ability to calm the nervous system, reduce fever, and treat respiratory issues, while its bioactive constituents include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
